summary: The compliance review of SakhiCredit's product identified several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. Key findings include: (1) The sharing of members' personal data with an insurance partner without prior explicit consent and disclosure of purpose violates data protection requirements. (2) The absence of a privacy policy on the website, despite plans to publish one next year, is a significant compliance gap. (3) Borrowers are not informed of their right to escalate rejected complaints to the RBI Ombudsman through the CMS portal. These issues require immediate attention to ensure compliance with RBI regulations.
